title: GPU + Quality Settings Demo
description: Demonstrates GPU acceleration and quality tier options. Use --gpu for hardware encoding, --quality draft|medium|high for speed/quality tradeoff.
script:
GPU acceleration makes rendering dramatically faster. [Visual: GPU graphics card computer] [Transition: fade]
Use --gpu to enable hardware encoding automatically. [Visual: video rendering progress bar] [Transition: slide] [Kinetic: on]
Quality draft mode is fastest for previews. [Visual: quick draft sketch] [Transition: fade]
Medium quality balances speed and output quality. [Visual: balanced scale] [Transition: slide]
High quality produces the best looking videos. [Visual: 4K resolution display] [Transition: fade] [Grade: cinematic]
Combine with --verbose to see full ffmpeg logs. [Visual: terminal code output] [Transition: slide]
GPU acceleration auto-detects your hardware. [Visual: NVIDIA AMD Intel logos] [Transition: fade]
